_comment: SN60's deployment settings. Read by kata-subnets-deploy's installer, which validates every
value against its allowlist and ceilings before rendering any unit. This file may set only
what a subnet decides for itself: challenge sizing, its own budget caps, and round timing.
Lane identity, source repo, plugin path, entry point, writable paths and public visibility are
the registry's; naming one here is refused outright, not ignored.
subnet_id and lane_id below are an ASSERTION, not an input: they are checked against the
registry lane so pointing the generator at the wrong checkout fails loudly.
